name: Argonne: GH200 x1, vLLM 0.6.1, Llama-2-7b-hf FP16, 2048io, batch 1
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). vLLM 0.6.1, BF16/FP16, 2048 in/2048 out, batch 1, 1x GH200 (96GB HBM3, Grace+Hopper superchip). Throughput = batch*(in+out)/end-to-end latency = AGGREGATE (batch-1 == per-request e2e rate incl prefill+decode). Reported latency n/as.
